preheader: Retail investors dump $338M, Fox buys Roku for $22B, and UCI's 7-foot-9 center debuts with a double-double.

lead.headline: Retail Investors Dump $338 Million in Stock Sell-Off Before Late Buying Rush
lead.body: Everyday investors sold a net $338 million in individual U.S. stocks on Thursday, marking the largest retail sell-off since the start of the COVID-19 pandemic. However, late buying in the final 10 minutes brought in over $100 million, cutting earlier net losses.
lead.why: Tracking how individual retail sentiment compares to institutional trading gives you practical context for finance classes and personal portfolio strategies during market swings.

stories.headline: Fox Corp Completes $22 Billion Acquisition of Roku
stories.body: Fox Corp. finalized its $22 billion purchase of streaming platform Roku to expand its digital presence alongside Tubi and FOX One. Executive Paul Cheesbrough will take on expanded duties to manage the combined operations.
stories.why: Analyzing media consolidation helps you evaluate how traditional networks buy distribution platforms to protect revenue streams.

stories.headline: Cathie Wood's ARK Invest Buys SpaceX and Nvidia Amid Market Dip
stories.body: ARK Invest purchased nearly $49 million in SpaceX shares and $46 million in Nvidia following a tech sell-off. To fund the moves, ARK sold $119.7 million in Broadcom stock and $20 million in CoreWeave.
stories.why: Seeing how high-profile asset managers adjust holdings during corrections offers real examples of portfolio rebalancing for your investment research.

stories.headline: DOJ Charges Three in $129 Million AI Executive Impersonation Scheme
stories.body: Federal prosecutors charged three individuals for using AI deepfakes and voice cloning to impersonate corporate executives and lawyers. The scheme allegedly stole over $129 million from thousands of companies.
stories.why: Understanding deepfake fraud risks is becoming essential for corporate risk evaluation and tech strategy consulting.

stories.headline: ING Puts $500 Million in Data Center Loans Up for Sale
stories.body: Dutch bank ING is seeking to sell about $500 million in data center debt, including loans financing OpenAI's Stargate project. Investors are growing cautious about the massive debt funding large compute buildouts.
stories.why: This loan sale highlights debt financing risks that could impact venture valuations and capital access for AI startups.

stories.headline: Deloitte Report Shows 28% of Companies See AI Revenue Growth
stories.body: A new Deloitte study found that 28% of businesses currently report revenue growth from AI investments, up from 20% earlier this year. However, many executives still lack clear insight into which specific tools generate real returns.
stories.why: Consulting clients will look for guidance on measuring true productivity and financial return on AI tool deployments.

stories.headline: Industry Leaders Warn Against Replacing Entry-Level Talent with AI
stories.body: Business experts warn that replacing interns and entry-level employees with AI creates long-term talent shortages. While AI handles research and summaries well, relying on it entirely reduces opportunities to build institutional knowledge.
stories.why: Understanding why firms still need junior talent helps you articulate your value during upcoming internship interviews.

stories.headline: 7-Foot-9 Center Olivier Rioux Dominates in UC Irvine Debut
stories.body: Olivier Rioux logged 13 points and 12 rebounds in 18 minutes during his UC Irvine debut, recording a double-double in a 92-66 victory over Chapman.

stories.headline: Alex Eala Advances to Hong Kong Open Semifinals
stories.body: Alex Eala defeated Croatia's Antonia Ruzic 7-6 (7), 7-5 to advance to the semifinal round at the Hong Kong Open after a two-hour match.

term.name: K-shaped economy
term.definition: A K-shaped economy describes an economic scenario where different parts of the population or business sectors recover and grow at vastly different rates. One group prospers while another declines. Bill Gates highlighted the concept when noting that billionaire taxes might be necessary to address widening wealth gaps driven by AI automation.

serve.headline: Zipline raised $1.5 billion at a $21.5 billion valuation
serve.body: Drone-delivery startup Zipline secured $1.5 billion in new funding to scale its autonomous logistics network. The investment comes as major retail partners like Walmart expand automated local delivery services.
